subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) The stones hit the frogs one by one. (b) An old man saw it and forbade the boys to kill them. (c) They found the playful frogs in the pond. (d) One day some boys were going by the side of the pond. (e) In a village there was a little pond where some frogs played and sang all the time. (f) Many of them were hurt very seriously and killed. (g) But the frogs did not know how to save their lives. (h) Then the boys began to throw stones into the pond for fun.
guide_solution: e → d → c → h → a →f → g → b 19
